study type: Secondary analysis of cross-sectional survey data
outcome: Early resumption of postpartum sexual intercourse
cohort: 6447 postpartum women in Ethiopia with children aged 0 to 36 months who participated in the 2016 Ethiopian Demographic and Health Survey
finding: The proportion of early resumption of postpartum sexual intercourse was high (60.41%) and was associated with several factors including maternal age, mode of delivery, child survival status, maternal education level, parity, fertility desires, family planning use, and maternal employment status.
mod_finding: Women who delivered by cesarean section were significantly less likely to resume sexual intercourse early postpartum (AOR = 0.34; 95% CI 0.23-0.49).
